content.title: Tiger Woods' Dating & Girlfriend History Includes Lindsey Vonn, Ex Wife Elin Nordegren
content.text: Key PointsTiger Woods' dating life includes high-profile relationships and a scandalous divorce from Elin Nordegren.Relationships with Lindsey Vonn and Erica Herman received public attention, each ending under unique circumstances.In 2025, Woods confirmed a new romance with Vanessa Trump, publicly announcing it on Instagram. Professional golfer Tiger Woods has had a dramatic and highly publicized dating life, including a failed marriage to a Swedish nanny, a three-year relationship with an Olympic skier, and, now, a romance with the president’s former daughter-in-law. Woods, 50, was arrested on suspicion of DUI on March 27 in Florida, after allegedly crashing into a truck’s trailer and then refusing to submit to a urinalysis test after blowing zero for alcohol-related impairment, according to the Martin County Sheriff. Neither Woods nor the other driver was injured, and Woods was alone in the car. That has renewed interest in Woods’ colorful dating history. Today, Tiger Woods’ Former Wife, Elin Nordegren, Has Kids With a Former NFL Player Elin Nordegren twirls her hair during commencement ceremonies at Rollins College in Winter Park, Fla., Saturday, May 10, 2014. Nordegren, the former wife of golfer Tiger Woods, was named the “Outstanding Graduating Senior” for Rollins College. (Stephen M. Dowell/Orlando Sentinel/Tribune News Service via Getty Images) Woods was married for six years to Elin Nordegren, a former Swedish model and nanny who is now a mental health counselor. They divorced in 2010 after a cheating scandal that erupted when Woods was in a crash in their driveway, and Nordegren smashed the window with a golf club to rescue him. According to Sports Illustrated, the crash occurred after a domestic argument when Woods’ wife discovered his affairs, and the resulting scandal blew up his perfect image. Nordegren told People Magazine that she was “blindsided” by Woods’ infidelities and embarassed, revealing, “I’ve been through hell.” “I never suspected, not a one,” she said in the exclusive interview. “For the last three-and-a-half years, when all this was going on, I was home a lot more with pregnancies, then the children and my school.” Four years later, in 2014, Nordegren sounded a different tune in another interview with People. “I have moved on and I am in a good place,” Nordegren told the publication. “My relationship with Tiger is centered around our children and we are doing really good – we really are – and I am so happy that is the case. He is a great father.” Woods spoke out about the divorce over the years. “You know, it’s a sad time in our lives,” he said when the split went through, according to ABC News. “And we’re looking forward in our lives and how we can help our kids the best way we possibly can. And that’s the important thing.” Woods and Nordegren have appeared at school functions together for their son, Charlie, who is trying to forge a career as a college golfer. They also share a daughter named Sam. Today, Nordegren presides over a blended family that includes three kids with Jordan Cameron, her former NFL playing boyfriend.Men's Journal NewslettersWe'll keep you in the know on the hottest new gear, whiskey releases, TV shows and movies, and deals everyone's talking about. Meanwhile, Woods’ former girlfriend, nightclub manager and hostess Rachel Uchitel has spoken out about the scandal. “Many people want to be famous. They think 10 minutes of fame’s fun,” she said in 2024, according to The New York Post. “But I’d become the villain. New York’s tragic face. For years I was the biggest story around. You cry. You’re torn apart. It affected my mental health. People betrayed me. Sold stories about me. Still today I am not close to my family.” Tiger Woods Dated Olympic Skier Lindsey Vonn for 3 Years Tiger Woods of the United States walks with his girlfriend Lindsey Vonn, son Charlie and daughter Sam during the Par 3 Contest prior to the start of the 2015 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 8, 2015 in Augusta, Georgia. (Photo by Jamie Squire/Getty Images) One of Woods’ highest profile relationships came with Olympic skier Lindsey Vonn. They dated for three years, breaking up in 2015, People reported. She spoke to ET about the relationship after Woods was in another car crash and revealed they remained friends. “We are friends and, of course, I’m happy that he is back and healthy,” she told ET. “And, you know, it was a tough time for him. So I am just happy that he is back with his kids.” She added: “Being an athlete and focusing 100 percent on my skiing, being in a relationship was difficult because I didn’t really want to fight or argue. So I just kind of compromised and I was like, ‘I’m traveling to them and I’m doing want they want to do too, and I’m having what dinner they want to have.’ I wanted to please and I just sacrificed myself.” Tiger Woods Had a Long Relationship With Erica Herman Tiger Woods poses with his daughter, Sam, son, Charlie and girlfriend Erica Herman after the World Golf Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony prior to THE PLAYERS Championship at PGA TOUR Global Home on March 9, 2022, in Ponte Vedra Beach, FL.(Photo by Chris Condon/PGA TOUR via Getty Images) Tiger Woods dated a woman named Erica Herman for six years, but it didn’t end as amicably; she sought both financial compensation and release from an NDA, according to Yahoo Sports. Herman’s court filing accuses Woods of having “decided to pursue a sexual relationship with his employee, then — according to him — forced her to sign an NDA about it or else be fired from her job. And, when he became disgruntled with their sexual relationship, he tricked her into leaving her home, locked her out, took her cash, pets, and personal possessions, and tried to strong-arm her into signing a different NDA.” According to Yahoo Sports, she alleged, “He told her to pack a bag for a short trip to the Bahamas, but when the two arrived at the airport, Woods told her to speak to his lawyer, and he boarded the plane without her.” “Then, Mr. Woods’s California lawyer, out of the blue, told her that she was not going anywhere, would never see Mr. Woods again, had been locked out of the house, and could not return,” Herman’s court filing states, according to Yahoo Sports. “She would not even be able to see the children or her pets again.” According to Yahoo Sports, Woods’ attorneys countered, “Ms. Herman was invited to live in the Residence while she was in a relationship with her former boyfriend, Eldrick Woods, who continues to live in the Residence with his two children. After Mr. Woods recently terminated the relationship, Ms. Herman was advised that she was no longer welcome in the Residence.” Tiger Woods Started Dating Vanessa Trump in 2025 In 2025, Woods confirmed another high-profile relationship, this one with Vanessa Trump, the ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr., with whom she shares five kids. Vanessa and her golfer daughter Kai Trump have been spotted at Woods’ golf tournaments, and Vanessa and Woods shared a kiss at a tournament on March 24. “Love is in the air, and life is better with you by my side! We look forward to our journey through life together,” Woods wrote in an Instagram post that confirmed the relationship.
